title: Job Trusts Heavenly Father’s Wisdom
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who wonders and asks why, and tonight Job stops needing every answer and trusts Heavenly Father’s wisdom: Wren asks why she can’t have a treat before dinner, doesn’t fully understand Mom’s answer, and trusts Mom’s love anyway.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she’s learning that we don’t have to understand everything. In Wren’s world today: Wren asked why she couldn’t have a treat before dinner, and Mom said, “Trust me — it’s so you’ll feel good later.” Wren didn’t fully understand, but she trusted Mom’s love. Just like Job trusted Heavenly Father’s wisdom without knowing everything, Wren learned that trust means believing in someone’s love and wisdom.
